verdict.rationale: Galileo's release notes mention an in-product AI Assistant for troubleshooting agentic systems, which is a direct in-product AI capability for getting help from your data. The evidence is a single thin line with no detail on what insights or suggestions it produces. LLM-as-a-judge metrics and auto-tuned evals are AI-scored evaluations rather than generated insights, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of what the AI Assistant analyzes and suggests (e.g., root-cause insights, fix recommendations), detail on how it surfaces suggestions in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Troubleshoot your agentic system with the AI Assistant.
